fields.Name: T330 - Operations to Run History Section Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises the container's two-section switching AND the second resource component (BulkOperationsRunHistory → RecordProcessHistoryComponent), a separate query path (MJ: Process Runs) from the Operations studio.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Bulk Operations'. Once the Operations section renders, click the 'Run History' item in the left-nav rail. The Run History surface should render with a 'Run history' heading, a 'Refresh' button, and either a run list (columns When / Operation / Entity / By / Status / Counts) or a 'No runs yet.' message. Then click 'Operations' in the rail to switch back and confirm the operations studio returns. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing both sections render when selected is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Selecting 'Run History' renders the run-history surface (run list with When/Operation/Status columns OR a 'No runs yet.' message)
Switching back to 'Operations' returns to the studio operations content
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
